title: Policies
subtitle: Manage security and operational guardrail policies across teams and keys

about.title: About Policies
about.desc: Use policies to group guardrails and control which ones run for specific teams, keys, or models.
about.why_1: Enable/disable specific guardrails for teams, keys, or models
about.why_2: Group guardrails into a single policy
about.why_3: Inherit from existing policies and override what you need

about_attachments.title: About Policy Attachments
about_attachments.desc: Policy attachments control where your policies apply. Policies don't do anything until you attach them to specific teams, keys, models, tags, or globally.
about_attachments.scope_keys: Applies only to specific API keys (supports wildcards like dev-*)
about_attachments.scope_models: Applies only when specific models are used
about_attachments.scope_tags: Matches tags from key/team metadata.tags or tags passed dynamically in the request body (metadata.tags). Use this to enforce policies across groups, e.g. "all keys tagged healthcare get HIPAA guardrails." Supports wildcards (prod-*).

enterprise_notice.title: Enterprise Feature Notice
enterprise_notice.desc: Parts of policy attachments will be on Enterprise in subsequent releases.
